name: Supabase
author: bytessavvy@gmail.com
description: Self-hosted Supabase (Postgres, Auth, REST, Realtime, Storage and Studio) in a single container, with an optional Cloudflare Tunnel for HTTPS without open ports. Secrets are generated on first start in secrets.env. Needs at least 2 GB of RAM.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Supabase ships entirely inside the Docker image, nothing is downloaded here.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/postgres /mnt/server/storage /mnt/server/snippets /mnt/server/functions
echo "Ready. Start the server to create the database and generate secrets.env."

variables.name: Public URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS address of Studio and the API, e.g. https://supabase.example.com. Used in auth emails, storage URLs and JWT issuer. Empty = http://localhost:<port>.

variables.name: Site URL
variables.description: Your application's URL, where auth emails redirect to. Empty = the public URL.

variables.name: Additional Redirect URLs
variables.description: Comma-separated extra URLs allowed as auth redirects.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel Token
variables.description: Token of a remotely-managed tunnel. In its Public Hostname use service HTTP and URL localhost:<server port>. Leave empty to run without the tunnel.

variables.name: Tunnel Protocol
variables.description: auto tries QUIC (UDP 7844) and falls back to HTTP/2. Use http2 if outbound UDP is blocked.

variables.name: Dashboard Username
variables.description: Username for Studio (HTTP basic auth).

variables.name: Dashboard Password
variables.description: Password for Studio. Empty = use the one generated in secrets.env. Needs at least one letter.

variables.name: Disable Signups
variables.description: Stop new users from signing up to your application.

variables.name: Enable Email Signups
variables.description: Allow email/password signups.

variables.name: Auto-confirm Emails
variables.description: Skip email confirmation. Turn on if you have not configured SMTP.

variables.name: Allow Anonymous Users
variables.description: Allow anonymous sign-ins.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server for auth emails (confirmations, magic links, resets).

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP port.

variables.name: SMTP User
variables.description: SMTP username.

variables.name: SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP password.

variables.name: SMTP Sender Email
variables.description: From address of auth emails.

variables.name: SMTP Sender Name
variables.description: From name of auth emails.

variables.name: Enable Realtime
variables.description: Run the Realtime service (about 150 MB of RAM).

variables.name: Enable Storage
variables.description: Run the Storage service, files are kept in storage/.

variables.name: Max Upload Size
variables.description: Storage upload limit in bytes (default 50 MB).

variables.name: JWT Expiry
variables.description: Access token lifetime in seconds.

variables.name: Database Port
variables.description: Internal Postgres port. To reach the database from outside, add an allocation to the server and put its port here (connections require the password from secrets.env).
